output.scope_note: The paper reports Li-ion conductivities of the solid electrolyte LiTi2(PS4)3 from impedance spectroscopy, so it is in scope.

records.synthesis_method: solid-state reaction with planetary ball milling, then hot pressing and sealed-tube annealing with sulfur
records.evidence_quote: found a lithium grain ionic conductivity of 6.1 mS/cm at 300K (Fig. S4, S5)
records.notes: Grain (bulk) conductivity. The 300 K value is an Arrhenius extrapolation (SI). The reported 300K temperature is kept as text; 300 K was not converted to Celsius. Activation energy 277 meV is from the grain conductivity Arrhenius fit (SI). Pellet was hot pressed at 200 C and then annealed at 400 C for 8 h (SI, Impedance spectroscopy).
